prompts.title: Architecture Suggester
prompts.when_to_use: you're starting a project and the blank architecture diagram is intimidating — get a simple, boring, correct structure.

prompts.title: Bug Repro Builder
prompts.when_to_use: someone (or you, last week) reported a bug in one vague sentence, and "it doesn't work" is not something you can fix.

prompts.title: Code Explainer
prompts.when_to_use: you opened a file someone else wrote (Stack Overflow, a teammate, AI-generated) and need to understand it line by line before you touch it.

prompts.title: Feature-to-Prompt Translator
prompts.when_to_use: you know what feature you want the AI to build, but your one-line request gets you junk code — this turns it into a prompt that works.

prompts.title: Library Picker
prompts.when_to_use: you're about to npm install something that will live in your codebase for years — choose with reasons, not vibes.

prompts.title: Code Migration Planner
prompts.when_to_use: you need to move code to a new version, framework, or pattern (class→hooks, JS→TS, REST lib→new API) without breaking everything at once.

prompts.title: Performance Fix Planner
prompts.when_to_use: your app is slow, everyone has opinions, and you need to find the actual bottleneck before buying a bigger server.

prompts.title: Prompt Improver (for coding)
prompts.when_to_use: the AI keeps giving you wrong or half-right code — the problem is usually your prompt, not the model. Fix the input.

prompts.title: Refactor Request Writer
prompts.when_to_use: your code works but it's turning into spaghetti — get a refactor that changes structure, never behavior.

prompts.title: Test Writer
prompts.when_to_use: you have working code and zero tests — get a test suite that catches real regressions, not vanity coverage.

prompts.title: Arabic Announcement Maker
prompts.when_to_use: you need to announce something to a community — a wedding invitation, a graduation celebration, a shop opening, a memorial notice — in Arabic, with the right tone for the occasion.

prompts.title: Arabic Job Application Email
prompts.when_to_use: you're applying to an Egyptian/Arab company by email (or responding to a hiring post) and need the message plus short attached-CV note that gets opened.

prompts.title: Occasion Speech Notes
prompts.when_to_use: you have to say a few words at a wedding, engagement, graduation, farewell, or work celebration — in Arabic, from the heart, in under two minutes.

prompts.title: Provider Complaint Letter
prompts.when_to_use: your internet/electricity/mobile provider (or any service company) failed you repeatedly and call-center loops got you nowhere — write the formal complaint that moves up the chain.

prompts.title: Egyptian Dialect Coach
prompts.when_to_use: you wrote (or plan to say) something in formal Arabic and it needs to sound Egyptian — natural, warm, and current — for a video, ad, presentation, or voice note.

prompts.title: Formal Arabic Email Writer
prompts.when_to_use: you need to write a formal Arabic email (to a company, ministry, university, or embassy) and want it correct, respectful, and taken seriously.

prompts.title: Official Terms Explainer
prompts.when_to_use: you're handed Egyptian paperwork — توكيل، إخلاء طرف، قسيمة، تصديق، مخخصصة، شهادة ميلاد حديثة — and the terms are a fog. Understand what each paper does before you queue at the real estate office or the notary.

prompts.title: Occasion Messages Writer
prompts.when_to_use: you need the right Arabic message — congratulations, condolences, get-well, invitation — and "alf mabrook" isn't enough, but a copy-paste cliché isn't you either.

prompts.title: Rental Contract Explainer
prompts.when_to_use: you're about to sign an Arabic rental contract (عقد إيجار) — or renew one — and want every clause in plain Arabic before your signature is on it.

prompts.title: School Note Writer
prompts.when_to_use: you need to write to your child's school in Arabic — absence excuse, early pickup, permission, or an inquiry to the teacher — quickly and correctly.

prompts.title: Booking Confirmation Message
prompts.when_to_use: someone booked your service or appointment and needs a confirmation message.

prompts.title: Contract Summary Checker
prompts.when_to_use: someone handed you a contract and you want to know what you're actually agreeing to before signing.

prompts.title: Business Idea Checker
prompts.when_to_use: you have a small business idea and want a blunt reality check for your local market before spending money.

prompts.title: Invoice Writer
prompts.when_to_use: you finished work for a client and need a clean invoice with the right wording.

prompts.title: Late Payment Chaser
prompts.when_to_use: your invoice is overdue, the friendly reminder failed, and you need an escalation ladder that gets paid without burning the relationship.

prompts.title: Price Explainer
prompts.when_to_use: a client says your price is too high and you need to justify it without panicking or instantly discounting.

prompts.title: Quotation Writer
prompts.when_to_use: a client asked "how much?" and you need a professional price quotation — not a WhatsApp number with no details.

prompts.title: Refund Apology Letter
prompts.when_to_use: you must refund a customer and you want to keep their trust (and maybe their business).

prompts.title: Customer Reply Writer
prompts.when_to_use: a customer messaged your store and you need a professional reply fast.

prompts.title: Supplier Email Writer
prompts.when_to_use: you need to ask a supplier for prices, samples, or better terms — and sound like a buyer they take seriously.

prompts.title: Career Switch Planner
prompts.when_to_use: you want to move into a different field and the internet says "just learn to code" — build a realistic bridge plan instead.

prompts.title: Cover Letter Writer
prompts.when_to_use: the job application asks for a cover letter and you want one that gets read — not a formal-template clone.

prompts.title: CV Reviewer
prompts.when_to_use: you have a CV and a job you want — this finds exactly why it isn't landing interviews for THAT job.

prompts.title: Freelance Profile Builder
prompts.when_to_use: your freelance profile (Mostaql, Khamsat, Upwork, Fiverr) gets views but no orders — rewrite it to convert.

prompts.title: Interview Prep Coach
prompts.when_to_use: you have an interview coming and want to practice answers out loud, not just read "top 50 questions".

prompts.title: LinkedIn Profile Fixer
prompts.when_to_use: recruiters search LinkedIn daily and your profile is invisible — optimize it to be found, not just to look nice.

prompts.title: Promotion Case Builder
prompts.when_to_use: you're doing the next level's job without the title or salary — build the written case that makes saying yes easy.

prompts.title: Rejection Response Writer
prompts.when_to_use: you got a "we went with another candidate" email and want to close gracefully — the graceful ones get the next offer.

prompts.title: Skills Gap Mapper
prompts.when_to_use: a job posting (or promotion) lists skills you half-have — map exactly what's missing and the fastest honest way to fill it.

prompts.title: STAR Story Builder
prompts.when_to_use: behavioral interviews ask "tell me about a time when..." and your answers ramble — build reusable STAR stories once, reuse them everywhere.

prompts.title: Social Bio Maker
prompts.when_to_use: your profile bio is empty, outdated, or says nothing — and you have 2 minutes to fix it.

prompts.title: Arabic Caption Writer
prompts.when_to_use: you have a photo or video ready and need an engaging Arabic caption for social media.

prompts.title: Carousel Outline Builder
prompts.when_to_use: you want a swipeable Instagram/LinkedIn carousel and need the slide-by-slide structure.

prompts.title: Comment Reply Writer
prompts.when_to_use: comments are piling up on your posts and you're replying with "Thanks! 🙏" — write replies that turn commenters into a community.

prompts.title: Content Calendar Builder
prompts.when_to_use: you post randomly when inspired and want a month of planned content instead.

prompts.title: Hashtag Finder
prompts.when_to_use: you want hashtags that actually help a post get discovered — not the same 5 dead tags everyone uses.

prompts.title: Newsletter Intro Writer
prompts.when_to_use: your newsletter opens with "We hope this email finds you well" and people are deleting it — write an opener that earns the scroll.

prompts.title: Post Hook Generator
prompts.when_to_use: your posts are good but nobody reads past the first line — fix the hook.

prompts.title: Product Description Writer
prompts.when_to_use: your product page or catalog needs descriptions that sell instead of listing specs.

prompts.title: Short Video Script Writer
prompts.when_to_use: you need a 30–60 second Reel/TikTok/Shorts script that people watch to the end.

prompts.title: Budget Splitter
prompts.when_to_use: payday came, and somehow the money is gone before the month ends.

prompts.title: Big Decision Matrix
prompts.when_to_use: you're stuck between two or three big options (job offer, city, degree, big purchase) and keep going in circles — score it once, properly.

prompts.title: Difficult Conversation Rehearsal
prompts.when_to_use: you keep rehearsing a hard conversation in your head — practice it out loud with a stand-in first, and walk in with lines that hold.

prompts.title: Monthly Expenses Review
prompts.when_to_use: the month ended, you know roughly what you spent and dread looking — turn your expenses list into a calm review with three fixes.

prompts.title: Habit Plan Builder
prompts.when_to_use: you want to build a habit and you keep quitting by day four.

prompts.title: Sleep Routine Fixer
prompts.when_to_use: you scroll until 2am and feel wrecked every morning.

prompts.title: Trip Packing List
prompts.when_to_use: you always arrive and realize you forgot something important.

prompts.title: Weekly Meal Planner
prompts.when_to_use: you ask yourself "what's for dinner" every day at 6pm and default to delivery — plan a week of meals once, on a budget.

prompts.title: Weekly Reset Routine
prompts.when_to_use: weeks blur together — tasks slip, inboxes pile up, Monday ambushes you — run one 45-minute reset that catches everything.

prompts.title: Beginner Workout Plan
prompts.when_to_use: you want to start exercising at home with no equipment and no idea where to begin.

prompts.title: Battery Drain Fixer
prompts.when_to_use: your phone or laptop battery dies way too fast and you want to know if it's software, settings, or an old battery.

prompts.title: Blue Screen (BSOD) Explainer
prompts.when_to_use: Windows just crashed with a blue screen and you wrote down the stop code.

prompts.title: Deploy Rollback Plan
prompts.when_to_use: a fresh deployment broke your site or app and you need to recover fast.

prompts.title: Email Bounce Fixer
prompts.when_to_use: your email bounces back, lands in spam, or never arrives — and you need to know which side has the problem.

prompts.title: Overheating Fixer
prompts.when_to_use: your laptop gets hot, the fan screams, or it throttles and shuts down — you need the cause, not just "clean the vents".

prompts.title: Phone Storage Fixer
prompts.when_to_use: your phone says "storage full" and apps keep crashing — you need space back without losing photos.

prompts.title: Printer Fixer
prompts.when_to_use: your printer refuses to print — offline, stuck queue, or blank pages — and you have a document due.

prompts.title: Slow PC Fixer
prompts.when_to_use: your Windows PC takes forever to open anything and you don't know why.

prompts.title: Website Error Fixer
prompts.when_to_use: your website or web app shows an error and you have no idea where to start.

prompts.title: Wi-Fi Drop Fixer
prompts.when_to_use: your internet keeps disconnecting on one or all devices and you can't tell if the problem is the router, the device, or the ISP.

prompts.title: API Error Decoder
prompts.when_to_use: an API returns an error code and the documentation didn't actually help.

prompts.title: Code Reviewer
prompts.when_to_use: you wrote code that works and want a senior engineer's eyes before the human review torches you.

prompts.title: Commit Message Writer
prompts.when_to_use: you have staged changes and "fixed stuff" is not a commit message.

prompts.title: Dockerfile Fixer
prompts.when_to_use: your Docker build fails, the image is huge, or the container crashes on run — build files fixed layer by layer.

prompts.title: Environment Mismatch Fixer
prompts.when_to_use: the code works on your teammate's machine (or the server) and dies on yours — "works on my machine" hunting.

prompts.title: Git Disaster Rescuer
prompts.when_to_use: git did something scary — wrong branch, lost commits, merge panic — and you're afraid to type anything else.

prompts.title: Log Analyzer
prompts.when_to_use: your app is failing and you have a wall of log lines — find the actual error, not the scariest-looking one.

prompts.title: README Writer
prompts.when_to_use: you built a project and the README is empty, messy, or embarrassing.

prompts.title: Regex Explainer
prompts.when_to_use: you found a regular expression in some code and have no idea what it actually matches.

prompts.title: SQL Query Fixer
prompts.when_to_use: your SQL query returns wrong rows, or it is slow and you do not know why.

prompts.title: Chart Picker
prompts.when_to_use: you have numbers to present and no idea which chart tells the story — pick the right one and design it so the point lands in 3 seconds.

prompts.title: Messy Data Cleaner
prompts.when_to_use: you exported/downloaded a spreadsheet or CSV and it's chaos — mixed dates, duplicates, merged cells, mystery columns — and you need a clean table.

prompts.title: Data Summarizer
prompts.when_to_use: you pasted a raw table of numbers and someone wants "the insights" — get the summary, the trends, and the honest caveats.

prompts.title: Duplicate Finder
prompts.when_to_use: two lists (or one messy list) should contain the same records but don't match up — customers, payments, inventory — find the mismatches and the dupes.

prompts.title: Excel Formula Builder
prompts.when_to_use: you know what you want a spreadsheet to do but not the formula — describe it in plain words, get the formula and the explanation.

prompts.title: File Organizer Planner
prompts.when_to_use: your Desktop/Downloads/Drive is a landfill of "final_v2_REAL.docx" and you need a system, not another cleanup that lasts a week.

prompts.title: Naming Convention Designer
prompts.when_to_use: your team's files are "doc final NEW (2).xlsx" and nobody can find anything — agree on a naming system once and stop the chaos.

prompts.title: PDF Data Extractor

prompts.title: Report Skeleton Builder
prompts.when_to_use: you have raw numbers and a monthly/weekly report due — build the report structure once, then it's fill-in-the-blanks forever.

prompts.title: Question-to-SQL Translator
prompts.when_to_use: you have a database and a plain-English question — get the SQL query AND the understanding, not a black-box answer.

prompts.title: Ad Copy Writer
prompts.when_to_use: you're putting money behind an ad (Meta, Google, TikTok) and need copy that converts — not slogans that sound nice.

prompts.title: Competitor Teardown
prompts.when_to_use: you're competing against 2–3 businesses doing it better (or cheaper) and need their playbook — and the gap they're leaving you.

prompts.title: Customer Persona Builder
prompts.when_to_use: you're marketing to "everyone" and it's not working — define the one person you're actually selling to.

prompts.title: Discount Offer Designer
prompts.when_to_use: you want to run a sale without training customers to wait for discounts or bleeding margin.

prompts.title: Welcome Email Sequence Writer
prompts.when_to_use: people sign up or inquire and hear nothing until you sell — set up a 3-email sequence that warms them up first.

prompts.title: Landing Page Copy Writer
prompts.when_to_use: you have traffic (ads, link in bio) hitting a page that converts nobody — write the page section by section.

prompts.title: Referral Offer Designer
prompts.when_to_use: word of mouth is your best channel and you're leaving it to luck — design a referral program customers actually use.

prompts.title: Review Request System
prompts.when_to_use: happy customers leave silently while your competitor has 200 reviews — build the ask that turns satisfaction into public proof.

prompts.title: Seasonal Campaign Planner
prompts.when_to_use: a big occasion is coming (Ramadan, Eid, back-to-school, Black Friday, Valentine's) and you scramble every year — plan the campaign before the season starts.

prompts.title: WhatsApp Broadcast Writer
prompts.when_to_use: you need to message your customers on WhatsApp (status, broadcast list, or groups) without getting muted or blocked.

prompts.title: Two-Factor Setup Guide
prompts.when_to_use: you know you should turn on 2FA but the options (SMS, app, keys) are confusing — pick the right method per account and set it up in one sitting.

prompts.title: Backup Plan Builder
prompts.when_to_use: your photos/thesis/client files live on ONE device and you know how that story ends — build the 3-2-1 backup system that runs itself.

prompts.title: Breach Response Playbook

prompts.title: Lost Device Playbook

prompts.title: Password Hygiene Coach
prompts.when_to_use: you have 40 accounts, 3 passwords you reuse everywhere, and a nagging feeling — build a system you can actually live with.

prompts.title: Phishing Spotter

prompts.title: Privacy Audit Runner

prompts.title: Public Wi-Fi Safety Coach

prompts.title: Safe Downloads Guide

prompts.title: Online Seller Scam Check

prompts.title: Essay Outline Builder

prompts.title: Exam Revision Planner
prompts.when_to_use: an exam is coming and you do not know how to split your remaining days.

prompts.title: Feynman Explain-Back

prompts.title: Flashcard Maker

prompts.title: Formula Explainer

prompts.title: Homework Hint Giver

prompts.title: Practice Quiz Generator

prompts.title: Meeting Agenda Builder

prompts.title: Meeting Notes Cleaner

prompts.title: One-on-One Prep

prompts.title: Out-of-Office Writer

prompts.title: Salary Negotiation Email

prompts.title: Task Priority Sorter
